dedupe_keys.name: sadeat stochastic anaerobic digestion economic assessment tool

description: SADEAT is a MATLAB model for economic assessment of anaerobic-digestion and combined heat-and-power projects. Its project repository publishes source so researchers and project planners can examine uncertain investment outcomes instead of relying on one deterministic case. Users supply digestion, energy and cost assumptions with probability distributions. The software samples these uncertain variables and reports economic feasibility across possible project conditions. Each run represents the user’s proposed plant and assessment horizon; there is no built-in geographic site or fixed time coverage. The source and instructions are public under GNU GPL version 3 or later, so the code is free to obtain. MATLAB R2015a or later, Financial Toolbox, Statistics and Machine Learning Toolbox, MATLAB Compiler and a GUI layout toolbox are separate requirements with their own terms and possible costs. SADEAT can support capacity or investment planning for biogas and waste-to-energy facilities. Its economics depend on the input distributions, so output cannot establish a particular plant’s feasibility without local evidence. No related catalogue record was identified. The model and its dependencies were not run.
